metadata.description: Management group whose current and future subscriptions receive the Defender for Cloud workflow automation. Use the tenant root management group to cover the full tenant.
Subscription that hosts the central Logic App, Office 365 connection, and deduplication storage.
Azure region for the central resources and per-subscription automation resource groups.
Resource group created in the central subscription.
Office 365 Outlook API connection name. This OAuth connection must be authorized once after deployment.
Prefix placed at the start of every notification subject.
How far back the Logic App queries Azure Resource Graph Change Analysis for potentially related ARM changes.
Days to retain deduplication markers. Repeated evaluation events for the same resource, recommendation, and state are suppressed during this period.
Resource group created in every governed subscription for the Defender for Cloud automation resource.
Name of the Microsoft.Security/automations resource created in every governed subscription.
Name of the management-group policy assignment.
Create an Azure Policy remediation task for subscriptions that already exist under the management group.

inputs.name: ScoreImpactHtml
inputs.value:
@concat('

Mapped security control: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_matching_control_score'))?['properties']?['displayName'], first(body('Find_matching_control_definition'))?['properties']?['displayName'], 'Unknown'), '

Control score now: ', formatNumber(float(coalesce(first(body('Find_matching_control_score'))?['properties']?['score']?['current'], 0)), '0.00'), ' / ', formatNumber(float(coalesce(first(body('Find_matching_control_score'))?['properties']?['score']?['max'], 0)), '0.00'), ' points across ', string(add(int(coalesce(first(body('Find_matching_control_score'))?['properties']?['healthyResourceCount'], 0)), int(coalesce(first(body('Find_matching_control_score'))?['properties']?['unhealthyResourceCount'], 0)))), ' scored resources.

Estimated maximum difference attributable to this affected resource: ', formatNumber(div(float(first(body('Find_matching_control_score'))?['properties']?['score']?['max']), float(add(int(coalesce(first(body('Find_matching_control_score'))?['properties']?['healthyResourceCount'], 0)), int(coalesce(first(body('Find_matching_control_score'))?['properties']?['unhealthyResourceCount'], 0))))), '0.000'), ' control points; ', formatNumber(mul(div(div(float(first(body('Find_matching_control_score'))?['properties']?['score']?['max']), float(add(int(coalesce(first(body('Find_matching_control_score'))?['properties']?['healthyResourceCount'], 0)), int(coalesce(first(body('Find_matching_control_score'))?['properties']?['unhealthyResourceCount'], 0))))), float(body('Get_subscription_secure_score')?['properties']?['score']?['max'])), 100), '0.000'), ' percentage points for this subscription', if(greater(float(variables('TotalManagementGroupWeight')), 0), concat('; ', formatNumber(mul(mul(div(div(float(first(body('Find_matching_control_score'))?['properties']?['score']?['max']), float(add(int(coalesce(first(body('Find_matching_control_score'))?['properties']?['healthyResourceCount'], 0)), int(coalesce(first(body('Find_matching_control_score'))?['properties']?['unhealthyResourceCount'], 0))))), float(body('Get_subscription_secure_score')?['properties']?['score']?['max'])), 100), div(float(body('Get_subscription_secure_score')?['properties']?['weight']), float(variables('TotalManagementGroupWeight')))), '0.000'), ' weighted percentage points for the selected management group'), ''), '.

This is a resource-level estimate, not a forecast. Defender recalculates controls about every eight hours, the current score can already include the finding, preview and custom recommendations do not score, and the management-group score is weighted.

')

body.query: securityresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.security/securescores' and name =~ 'ascScore' | extend scorePercentage=todouble(properties.score.percentage), scoreWeight=todouble(properties.weight) | where isnotnull(scorePercentage) and isnotnull(scoreWeight) and scoreWeight > 0 | extend weightedScore=scorePercentage * scoreWeight | summarize overallPercentage=round(100.0 * sum(weightedScore) / sum(scoreWeight), 2), totalWeight=sum(scoreWeight), subscriptionCount=dcount(subscriptionId)

inputs.name: OverallScoreHtml
inputs.value:
@if(empty(body('Get_management_group_secure_score')?['data']), '

Management-group Secure Score is unavailable for this event.

', concat('

Selected management-group score: ', formatNumber(float(first(body('Get_management_group_secure_score')?['data'])?['overallPercentage']), '0.00'), '% across ', string(first(body('Get_management_group_secure_score')?['data'])?['subscriptionCount']), ' scored subscriptions. This is the classic weighted Secure Score calculated from Azure Resource Graph data.

'))

inputs.name: ResourceChangesHtml
inputs.value:
@if(empty(body('Get_recent_resource_changes')?['changes']), concat('

No Azure Resource Manager changes were recorded for this resource during the last ', string(parameters('resourceChangeLookbackHours')), ' hours.

'), concat('
', replace(replace(replace(string(take(body('Get_recent_resource_changes')?['changes'], 5)), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '
'))

body.Body:
Microsoft Defender for Cloud recommendation raised

Detected: @{utcNow()}

Recommendation@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['displayName'], triggerBody()?['properties']?['metadata']?['displayName'], 'Not supplied')}
Severity@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['metadata']?['severity'], 'Not supplied')}
Status@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['status']?['code'], 'Not supplied')}
Status cause@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['status']?['cause'], 'Not supplied')}
Status detail@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['status']?['description'], 'Not supplied')}
Subscription@{variables('SubscriptionName')} (@{variables('SubscriptionId')})
Affected resource@{if(empty(variables('ResourceId')), coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['resourceDetails']?['machineName'], 'Not supplied'), last(split(variables('ResourceId'), '/')))}
Resource source@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['resourceDetails']?['source'], 'Not supplied')}
Resource ID@{if(empty(variables('ResourceId')), 'Not supplied', variables('ResourceId'))}
Assessment ID@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['name'], 'Not supplied')}
Assessment type@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['metadata']?['assessmentType'], 'Not supplied')}
Preview@{string(coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['metadata']?['preview'], false))}
Categories@{join(coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['metadata']?['categories'], createArray('Not supplied')), ', ')}
Threats@{join(coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['metadata']?['threats'], createArray('Not supplied')), ', ')}
Implementation effort@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['metadata']?['implementationEffort'], 'Not supplied')}
User impact@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['metadata']?['userImpact'], 'Not supplied')}
Policy definition@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['metadata']?['policyDefinitionId'], 'Not supplied')}

Description

@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['metadata']?['description'], 'No description supplied.')}

Recommended remediation

@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['metadata']?['remediationDescription'], 'No remediation guidance supplied.')}

What changed in the environment

Defender assessment change: the affected resource is currently evaluated as @{coalesce(triggerBody()?['properties']?['status']?['code'], 'unknown')}. The recommendation event does not guarantee an exact before/after configuration diff. The recent ARM changes below are best-effort correlation data and might not be the cause of the recommendation.

@{variables('ResourceChangesHtml')}

Secure Score

Effect of sending this notification: 0 points. Email delivery itself never changes Secure Score.

@{variables('SubscriptionScoreHtml')}@{variables('OverallScoreHtml')}@{variables('ScoreImpactHtml')}

Classic Secure Score controls are normally recalculated about every eight hours. The newer risk-based Cloud Secure Score in the Defender portal is a different model and is not projected by this workflow.

Open in Defender for Cloud

View recommendation in Azure portal

Deduplication: @{if(equals(outputs('Create_deduplication_marker')?['statusCode'], 201), 'marker created successfully.', concat('marker creation did not return HTTP 201 (status ', string(coalesce(outputs('Create_deduplication_marker')?['statusCode'], 'unavailable')), '); this email was sent to avoid losing the alert.'))}

The complete Defender event payload is attached as JSON. Duplicate events for the same resource, recommendation, and state are suppressed for the configured retention period.
